out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED HAND SINK AT CEVICHE STATION WITH STRAINER IN BASIN. OBSERVED HAND SINK NEXT TO COOKLINE/GRILL WITH ICE IN BASIN.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CFM WILL DISCUSS WITH EMPLOYEES THAT HAND SINKS ARE ONLY USED FOR HAND WASHING.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. OBSERVED HAND SINK WITH NO SOAP LOCATED AT COOK LINE/GRILL.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. EMPLOYEE REFILLED HAND SOAP.

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: OBSERVED MAXIMUM HOT WATER SANITIZING TEMPERATURE AT HIGH TEMPERATURE DISH MACHINE AT 150F.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. EHS DISCUSSED WITH CFM THAT DISH MACHINE CAN BE USED TO WASH AND RINSE DISHES AND 3 COMPARTMENT SANITIZER BASIN MUST BE SET UP WITH QUATERNARY AMMONIA OR BLEACH FOR SANITIZING.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: FAJITA VEGETABLES (ONIONS, PEPPERS) ON TABLE.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. CFM HAD EMPLOYEE LABEL FOOD WITH 4 HOUR END POINT OF 3PM.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. Observed no paper towels at hand sink at ceviche station.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. Employee provided paper towels.

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Observed hot water dish machine with maximum irreversible registering thermometer reading of 145F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the dishmachine so that 160F temperature is achieved using an irreversible registering thermometer. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces after being ran through dish machine. EHS will follow up in 3 days or when CFM reaches out to confirm repair, whichever comes first. GUAPOS OF FAIR LAKES (Inspection Date: 12/29/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. Observed no paper towels at hand sink at ceviche station.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CFM provided paper towels.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed hand sink at dish area being used to wring out excess liquid from wet wiping cloth. Observed hand sink at ceviche station with sieve over basin with food debris inside.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS reviewed designated use of hand sink with CFM. CFM will discuss with staff that hand sinks are for hand washing only.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the chlorine-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the sanitizer bucket at ceviche station with a concentration of 0 ppm total chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: A chlorine-based sanitizing solution shall have a minimum concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine when tested using the appropriate test kit. CFM had employee remake chlorine sanitizer solution and use test kit to verify concentration.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wet wiping cloths throughout kitchen area stored on counters.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CFM reminded employees to keep wiping cloths in sanitizer buckets. GUAPOS OF FAIR LAKES (Inspection Date: 06/13/2025) Page 3 of 4

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed knives stored in between prep units at cook line.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS showed CFM and employees proper storage of in use-utensils.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed ceiling tiles above dish machine with mold-like substance.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. CFM will replace ceiling tiles.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed mold-like substance on caulking and peeling caulking at 3 compartment sink and surrounding dish machine area.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. CFM will request caulking be replaced.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock, Retaining Labels/Tags for 90 Days
violations.observation: The tags for the molluscan shellfish are not being retained for 90 days. CFM stated tags may have been discarded while area was being cleaned.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels for 90 calendar days from the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served using one of the following methods: 1) an approved record keeping system that keeps the tags or labels in chronological order correlated to the date when the last shellstock from a container are sold or served, 2) preserving source identification by using a record keeping system, and 3) ensuring that shellstock from one tagged or labeled container are not commingled with shellstock from another container with different certification numbers, different harvest dates, or different growing areas as identified on the tag or label before being ordered by the consumer. CFM IS AWARE TAGS NEED TO BE KEPT ON FILE FOR AT LEAST 90 DAYS.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: on the brunch menu does not have the consumer advisory statement and asterisk for poached eggs, steak, eggs (offered undercooked).
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. PROVIDE EHS WITH DOCUMENTATION FOR UPDATED BRUNCH MENU WITHIN 10 DAYS.
